Good morning. This is a message from the Buenos Aires office. Here is how our week works. We always start at eight in the morning, every day. The finance meeting is on Monday, and it never starts late, so please arrive early. We usually have lunch at one o'clock. On Wednesday the team often works from home, so the office is very quiet that day. On Friday we always finish at four in the afternoon. And one small thing: the coffee machine sometimes stops in the afternoon, so take your coffee in the morning. Thank you, and have a very good week.

Hello, and welcome to your hotel in Paris. This is a short message about your days with us. Breakfast is always from six thirty to ten in the morning. It is usually very quiet before eight o'clock, so if you like a calm breakfast, come early. The city is often very busy on Saturday, and the museums are sometimes closed on Monday, so please ask us before you go out. Our taxi is always at the door, but in the morning it sometimes takes ten minutes. And one last thing: we never close the front desk. If you need us at three in the morning, we are here. Have a very good day.
Thaís always wakes up at five in the morning. She usually has coffee at home. She is always at the airport two hours early. On the plane, she often works. She never opens her email on vacation.
